items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: Now, that was a job that Mr. Pierce, Billy Pierce gave me, see I could be like a Buddy Bradley assistant dancer, see.

ctx.x: And I still do one of the steps I taught her. I even do it now, I mean, and I do a dance to the melody of 'Caravan,' you see, that's a Duke Ellington melody, and I do some of the Eleanor Powell tap in that, see, that I taught her for Mr. Buddy Bradley, because he wasn't there.
Now, that was a job that Mr. Pierce, Billy Pierce gave me, see I could be like a Buddy Bradley assistant dancer, see. You know, but --
Were there other assistants also working then?
